Slazeya cloud functions: source and license notices

Adapted: Stefan Gustavson periodic classic 3D pnoise; Sebastian Lague periodic
Worley F1 / normalization, lightmarch and HG. Its density/erosion method informed
the local ring implementation; the earlier inverse-cubed formula was replaced.
Recipe reference: Sebastien Hillaire, TileableVolumeNoise main.cpp Perlin-Worley
and FBM packing. GLM, Shadertoy, simplex noise and HDRP implementation are not copied.
Exact files, commits and SHA256 are in cloud-source-references.json.
